newsitem.title: USA: Michael Jackson friend is pregnant with his child.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson friend is pregnant with his child.

text.p: A longtime friend of Michael Jackson is pregnant with his child and is expected to have the baby early next year, the pop star's publicist said on Monday.
Publicist Regina Santoz said the woman, Debbie Rowe, had been a "close friend" of the singer for 15 years. She denied reports that Jackson had paid Rowe to carry his child.
Santoz also denied reports that Rowe has been artificially inseminated but declined to comment when asked about the couple's sexual relationship.
"She is pregnant with his child and she should have it by early 1997," Santoz told Reuters.
She said that Jackson was not ready to talk about how the child would be raised but added, "I'm sure that Michael is going to be giving this child 100 percent support."
